app.name: Murmur
menu.hotkey.edit: Select text, then hold {key} to edit it
onboarding.title: Set up Murmur
onboarding.subtitle: Murmur needs a few permissions. Only the microphone is required.
onboarding.mic.title: Microphone
onboarding.mic.body: Murmur needs microphone access to hear you. It listens only while you hold the hotkey.
onboarding.ax.title: Accessibility
onboarding.ax.body: Lets Murmur type into the app you're using and read the text under your cursor when you ask.
onboarding.screen.title: Screen recording
onboarding.screen.body: Optional. Lets the agent look at the area around your pointer when there is no text to read.
onboarding.elevated_note: Murmur can't type into apps running as administrator.
report.title: What changed
report.copied: Couldn't paste. Text is on your clipboard. Check Accessibility / Input Monitoring.
report.secure_field: Murmur doesn't type into password fields
approval.title: Check before Murmur acts
notch.waiting.hint: Approvals are waiting. They show here when the notch is free.
notch.focus_hint: Click or press ⌃⌥A to use the keyboard
panel.title: Tasks
panel.empty: No tasks yet. Hold {key} and ask Murmur to do something.
settings.title: Settings
settings.sound: Play a sound when listening starts and stops
settings.launch_at_login: Open Murmur when you log in
settings.toggle_mode: Tap the hotkey to start and stop, instead of holding it
settings.spoken_punctuation: Turn spoken "comma" and "new line" into symbols
settings.learning: Suggest dictionary words from my corrections
settings.save_lost: Murmur didn't keep this choice. Choose it again, or type the full path in the field.
settings.llm.chatgpt.help: Use your ChatGPT plan instead of an API key. Murmur shows a code; you enter it on OpenAI's page.
settings.llm.chatgpt.code: Enter this code on the page:
settings.llm.chatgpt.waiting: Waiting for you to finish signing in…
settings.llm.key_failed: Couldn't save the key in your keychain: {error}
settings.llm.missing: Agent mode needs a model. Add a local server address or an API key.
settings.connectors.skeleton: Needs your own OAuth client ID
settings.connectors.mcp_help: Add a server from Terminal: murmur add mcp <name> -- <command>
settings.save_transcripts.help: Off by default. Audio is never saved.
settings.diagnostics.help: Off by default. Never includes text, audio, app names or file names.
settings.delete_all.confirm: Delete your history, dictionary, settings and saved keys? This can't be undone.
error.no_stt: Choose a speech model in Settings first
error.no_mic: Murmur can't use the microphone. Allow it in Settings.
agent.no_llm: Agent mode needs a model. Open Settings to add one.
agent.step_limit: I stopped because the task needed too many steps.
agent.time_limit: I stopped because the task took too long.
settings.connectors.client_id_missing: Add your OAuth client ID for this connector first.
update.manual: Murmur can't replace itself in this folder. The disk image is open: drag Murmur to Applications.
update.no_asset: The new version is still being prepared. Try again in a few minutes.
update.err.no_checksum: The release has no checksum for its disk image, so it wasn't installed.
update.err.checksum: The download didn't match its checksum, so it wasn't installed.
update.err.bundle: The downloaded app failed a check ({why}), so it wasn't installed.
update.notify_body: Choose Install in the Murmur menu to update.
models.none: No speech model yet. Download one to start dictating.
models.languages: Parakeet v3 understands English and 24 other European languages and detects which one you speak. It doesn't do Japanese: pick whisper.cpp for that.
models.attribution: Model by NVIDIA (CC BY 4.0), converted for whisper.cpp by ggml-org.
onboarding.model.title: Speech model
onboarding.model.body: Murmur turns your voice into text on this Mac with NVIDIA Parakeet. Download it once (about {size} MB); nothing is sent anywhere.
settings.apps.intro: Connect Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack, Notion and hundreds more through Composio, so the agent can use them. Sign-in happens on each app's own page.
settings.apps.key_help: Get a free key at composio.dev. Murmur keeps it in your keychain.
settings.apps.waiting: Finish signing in on the page that opened…
settings.apps.privacy: What the agent reads from these apps passes through Composio's servers. Anything that sends or changes something still shows you a preview first.
settings.apps.need_key: Add your Composio key to connect apps.
typing.prompt.edit: Say how to change the selected text…
typing.hint: Return to send · Esc to close
typing.no_selection: Nothing selected: the result goes at the cursor
settings.tts.title: Spoken replies
settings.tts.help: Uses your Mac's voices. Nothing leaves your Mac.
settings.tts.sample: Hi, this is how I will sound.
circle.title: Ask about this
circle.need_permission: Murmur needs Screen Recording to see what you circle. Allow it in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen Recording, then try again.
circle.needs_macos14: Circle to Ask needs macOS 14 or later.
circle.prompt.search: Search the web for this and tell me what you find.
circle.prompt.translate: Translate the text in this into English.
menu.hotkey.circle: Circle to Ask: hold {key}, then drag
typing.attach_screen: Include a picture of my window
settings.circle.title: Circle to Ask and screen
settings.circle.enabled: Hold {key} and drag to circle something
settings.screen.attach: Include a picture of my window with every Ask
settings.circle.help: Murmur reads the words in the area on your Mac and sends the picture only to your own AI provider. Nothing is kept.
settings.agents.title: Coding agents
settings.agents.help: Murmur can start these agents and show their questions in the notch. Nothing is allowed unless you say yes. Say “ask Codex to…” to start one.
settings.computer.permission: Needs Accessibility permission to click and type in other apps.
settings.approval.title: How should Murmur's actions be approved?
settings.approval.ask.help: Always show what Murmur will do first, for anything that changes something or acts on your computer.
settings.approval.auto.help: Only ask for actions that could be risky: sending to other people, deleting, buying, or pressing something like Send.
settings.approval.full.help: Never ask. Murmur can send, delete and use any app on your computer without showing you first.
settings.approval.full.confirm.title: Turn on Full access?
settings.approval.full.confirm.body: Murmur will act on your Mac, your files and your connected apps without asking. A web page or email it reads could trick it into doing something harmful. You can change this back at any time.
indicator.locked_hint: Press the key again to stop · Esc to cancel
settings.double_tap_lock: Tap the dictation key twice to keep listening
settings.double_tap_lock.help: Tap the key twice quickly and Murmur keeps listening hands-free. Press the key once more to stop.
